Raw. No additives. No Fillers. Wild-Crafted, Authentic Sourced from pristine and remote Himalayan regions at altitudes above 16,000 ft (~5km). High Standard Production Produced using low-heat production. No chemicals used during processing. Just pure and clean water. Complies with U.S. federal and state laws. See COA Analysis Results: 10g, 30g, 60g. Why do we call it the Best Shilajit Ever™? High Altitude Harvesting makes all the difference. Our shilajit is the best because it is collected from the Himalayas at high altitude. Harvesting at high altitudes is physically challenging for the harvesters, but it assures that we are getting the cleanest, most pure form, and best shilajit possible. High-altitude Shilajit has spent the least amount of time running down the mountain. Why is this important? The longer the shilajit seeps down the mountain, the more chances it has to gather impurities. Just like spring water collected at the source is cleaner than river water downstream, shilajit harvested at high altitude is generally purer than lower elevation varieties. We do the least amount of processing possible. After harvesting, we dissolve the Himalayan Shilajit Resin in clean water, filter it to remove impurities, then concentrate it into a paste using low heat. Nothing is added to it during the entire processing. The Best Shilajit Ever™ is a pure, premium-grade Himalayan shilajit resin prepared with minimal processing. Beware of shilajit powders and capsules that were prepared using spray drying, which use very high heat that degenerates micronutrients. Packaged in beautiful Miron Violet Glass, a unique, deep violet “biophonic” glass that shields ingredients from damaging light rays while still allowing some UVA and infrared light waves in. Miron Violet Glass protects the potency and taste of pure Himalayan Shilajit. What exactly is Shilajit Resin? Shilajit comes from ancient plants that have naturally and slowly decomposed deep within the rocks of the Himalayan mountains. During the summer, the pure Shilajit resin seeps out from the rocks due to the intense heat. It’s incredibly nutritious, containing a number of valuable minerals such as iron, calcium, copper, magnesium, phosphorous, zinc, silica and more, as well as other organic plant materials, amino acids, fulvic and humic acid and antioxidants. A Time-Tested, Ayurvedic Favorite Pure Himalayan shilajit resin has been used in traditional Ayurveda for thousands of years to help balance the three doshas (Vata, Pitta, and Kapha). The name, Shilajit, means “Conqueror of Mountains” and “Destroyer of Weakness.” It’s a thick, sticky, mineral-rich resin that’s traditionally been used for rejuvenation and nourishment. Ayurvedic practitioners favor Himalayan shilajit for its reputed benefits in traditional use, such as sustaining energy levels and promoting overall vitality. WE AREN'T JUST A RESELLER. WE WENT TO THE SOURCE. We traveled to the Himalayas. "In 2019, I realized one of my dreams to hike in the Himalayas. I was inspired by the beauty of Himalayas and thought we would offer products that are sourced from there to our customers.
